allowed_evidence.diagnosis_document_policy: Any document used to discover or repair a failure is excluded from the confirmation groups for that repair.
allowed_evidence.question_only_policy: Question-only variants may close compiler invariance gates but never company/layout/source-backed gates.

qp4_scope.purpose: Stress the frozen financial-report QA core with meaning-preserving long/surface variants and meaning-changing minimal pairs without expanding the system into general KG completion.
supported_task_boundary: financial report search and question answering
verified partial or complete summary audit
out_of_scope: free-form causal generation without cited evidence
cross-document reasoning without an explicit separately precommitted protocol
conversation-state inference without explicit state proof

semantic_projection_v1.commutative_policy: Canonicalize operand order only for an operation declared commutative by the frozen typed program contract; preserve order for subtraction, division, percent change and every direction/reference-base-sensitive DAG.
semantic_projection_v1.equivalence_rule: Equivalent surfaces must have identical semantic QuestionPlan projection, eligible_program_set signature and winner signature. A baseline ABSTAIN or REJECT must retain the same fail-closed semantic outcome and may never be promoted.

minimal_pair_counterfactual_contract.construction_rule: Change exactly one declared semantic dimension while keeping metric identity and every unrelated qualifier fixed. Record the changed slot and retain both source questions.
minimal_pair_counterfactual_contract.old_program_rule: The pre-mutation typed program may not remain an ANSWER for the mutated question. An explicit semantic mismatch must make its applicable proof INVALID; removal or absence of required proof must be UNKNOWN and ABSTAIN.
minimal_pair_counterfactual_contract.new_program_rule: A semantically changed question may compile to and verify a different typed program only when every new slot and proof obligation is explicit and VALID.

mutation_taxonomy.mutation: Change exactly one ACTUAL/PLAN/REVISED_PLAN/FORECAST role while preserving metric, year, entity and unit.
mutation_taxonomy.expected_old_program: INVALID when the old role is contradicted; UNKNOWN then ABSTAIN when the role is removed.
mutation_taxonomy.required_control: Swapped-role and missing-role are separate records.

mutation_taxonomy.mutation: Change exactly one operand period/year and preserve the other operand identities.
mutation_taxonomy.expected_old_program: INVALID period proof; no acceptance because execution happens to match.
mutation_taxonomy.required_control: Cover both same-role two-year and mixed role/year programs when applicable.

mutation_taxonomy.expected_old_program: INVALID entity/scope proof, or UNKNOWN then ABSTAIN when requested scope lacks evidence.
mutation_taxonomy.required_control: Cross-scope comparison is valid only when explicitly requested and separately typed.

mutation_taxonomy.mutation: Change requested unit family or scale without changing the underlying metric.
mutation_taxonomy.expected_old_program: Old unit/scale output is invalid; a new answer requires explicit proof-backed exact conversion, otherwise UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN or contradiction/REJECT.
mutation_taxonomy.required_control: Display scale never feeds execution and an unproved x1000 mutation never passes.

mutation_taxonomy.mutation: Reverse signed direction or change increase/exceed to decrease/shortfall while holding operands fixed.
mutation_taxonomy.required_control: Do not use ADD as a swapped-operand negative because ADD is commutative.

mutation_taxonomy.mutation: Change or remove the denominator/reference base of a ratio or percent-change question.
mutation_taxonomy.expected_old_program: INVALID for an explicit different base; UNKNOWN and ABSTAIN when the base is missing.
mutation_taxonomy.required_control: Reference-base mutations apply only to denominator-sensitive programs.

oracle_outcomes.different_complete_typed_program: ANSWER only for the new program; old program remains non-answerable

category_rules.SHORT_LONG_EQUIVALENT: Add report/table discourse and restate every original qualifier without adding or removing semantic slots.
category_rules.DISCOURSE_PREFIX_SUFFIX: Ignore discourse framing only; preserve metric, role, period, entity, unit, direction and reference base.
category_rules.CLAUSE_PERMUTATION: Permute clauses only when operand attachment remains explicit; otherwise classify as semantic change or ambiguity, not equivalence.
category_rules.NO_DIACRITICS: Remove Vietnamese diacritics without changing tokens or numbers.
category_rules.BILINGUAL_PARENTHETICAL: Add a verified metric alias or unit gloss in parentheses; a non-equivalent translation is not a positive.
category_rules.IRRELEVANT_DISTRACTOR_CLAUSE: Add a clause explicitly outside the requested calculation and containing no competing requested qualifier.

rules.REPEATED_METRIC: Answer only when typed qualifiers and provenance select one logical cell; otherwise UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN.
rules.CONFLICTING_CELL: Explicit contradiction is INVALID and REJECT; never choose by score.
rules.COMPETING_LOGICAL_CELL: Same numeric value is not equivalent without proven semantic and provenance equivalence.
rules.PERCENT_NEAR_ABSOLUTE: Unit and role proof must reject an adjacent percent/absolute substitution.
rules.DISTRACTOR_TABLE_OR_SUBTABLE: A different table/subtable may bind only with explicit lineage and scope proof.
rules.CANDIDATE_PERMUTATION: Eligible set, winner, action and proof snapshot are invariant to candidate input order.

MULTI_OUTPUT.contract: Decompose to an explicit requested-output inventory with answer_mode_complete proof, or ABSTAIN with multi_answer_not_supported/incomplete reason.
MULTI_OUTPUT.answered_definition: All requested outputs independently verified; partial verified rows do not count as a complete answer.

QUALITATIVE_FOLLOW_UP.contract: Render a qualitative claim only from a direct cited text span; a verified numeric answer does not license an uncited cause.
QUALITATIVE_FOLLOW_UP.answered_definition: Both requested numeric and qualitative parts verified, otherwise explicit partial coverage or ABSTAIN.

ANAPHORA.contract: Require explicit conversation-state proof for references such as this metric/that year/the company above; never infer from nearby text or absence.
ANAPHORA.answered_definition: Resolved state identity and all downstream proof VALID; otherwise ABSTAIN.

CROSS_DOCUMENT.contract: Outside the current single-document contract unless a separate protocol explicitly binds both document identities, scopes, periods, units and provenance.
CROSS_DOCUMENT.answered_definition: No current QP4 coverage claim; expected safe ABSTAIN unless a later separately precommitted protocol is opened.

source_backed_end_to_end.existing_qp3_cohort_policy: May seed source eligibility only; it does not count for a QP4 dimension unless the required question pair, oracle, proof and end-to-end replay are independently reviewed.

forbidden_selection_inputs: company identity as a preferred rule
example or family id as runtime logic
development_cohort_contract.unseen_company_and_layout_claim_policy: Report only groups explicitly reserved as development confirmation; never claim universal or sealed unseen performance.

runtime_change_admission.generic_evidence_required: A failure cluster must recur across at least 3 development companies, 3 source documents and 3 real layout families, or be a pure compiler-only semantic invariance failure independent of document layout.
runtime_change_admission.conditional_scope_rule: Edit only the smallest whitelisted symbol group directly responsible for a failed frozen oracle. Passing layers remain byte-frozen.

symbols: direct private compiler helpers called by those symbols
src/hrm_finance_qa/question_planner.py.allowed_change: Generic semantic normalization and typed intent compilation needed to satisfy frozen meaning-preserving and meaning-changing question oracles. No question literal, family ID, fixed year/value or evidence inference.

src/hrm_finance_qa/program_synthesis.py.allowed_change: Only if the baseline proves a typed eligible-program-set failure after the compiler projection is correct; bind generic typed slots and provenance without rank/score as proof.

src/hrm_finance_qa/symbolic_verifier.py.allowed_change: Only if old-program INVALID/UNKNOWN proof states are wrong despite correct typed intent and candidate binding; preserve tri-state fail-closed semantics.

src/hrm_finance_qa/direction_contract.py.allowed_change: Only for a generic ordered-operand direction failure reproduced across the frozen direction taxonomy; ADD commutativity is not a direction negative.

edit a runtime file or symbol outside the exact conditional whitelist

use candidate rank, neural score, confidence, absence or nearby context as semantic proof

count score decrease as counterfactual rejection
count synthetic layout or question variants as source-backed confirmation
use ABW as confirmation or gate
